dimension: dataset structural/integrity claims and analysis-unit discipline of the deliverable

method_concerns: SoC = 50 % probe depends on linear interpolation across per-curve sampling gaps up to 36.83 percentage points (charge setting 1, 754x that curve's median step); Result.md never quantifies this interpolation sensitivity. My monotone-cubic (PCHIP) recheck gave RMSE 0.1838 vs 0.1837 pp and preserved all orderings, so the conclusions survive, but the unreported sensitivity is a real gap.

The headline 95 % CI for the 600-cycle slope is block-length dependent: block=25 gives [-0.1346,-0.1117] as reported; block=50 gives [-0.1412,-0.1118]; block=100 gives [-0.156,-0.108]; Newey-West HAC with 100 lags gives [-0.134,-0.106]. Only one block length is presented.

Charge settings 6 and 7 are a template copy (bit-identical 47-point abscissa, exact constant +0.041520 V offset), so the charge branch has at most 6 independent rate levels; n=7 charge-family statistics (e.g. charge contribution +0.1916 V, Spearman rho = 1.0) are inflated by this pseudo-replication. Result.md flags the copy qualitatively but does not adjust any n=7 charge-side figure.

The Finding 2 linkage between the 7 anonymous rate settings and the 9 anonymous rate values is an inference (rank 1 of 5040 permutations), not a supplied key; the report labels it as such, but all downstream estimates inherit it.

No place in the deliverable computes a statistic over 852 or 600 raw points with an iid-derived uncertainty; block resampling is used consistently, which is the correct treatment for this repeated-observation structure.
summary: Every one of the nine structural/integrity claims is confirmed by my own independent recomputation: row counts 852/16/600, 7+7 curves one per rate_setting_1..7, point counts 45-84, the stated SoC spans, strict monotonicity everywhere except charge settings 6 and 7 (one flat voltage step at SoC 99.84835->99.90269), exactly one bit-identical within-role abscissa pair, all three sha256 digests matching data_manifest.json, and the exact summary_role/unit partition. No unlisted categorical values exist, and no duplicate rows, duplicate (setting, SoC, voltage) triples, or cross-file value coincidences were found. Analysis-unit discipline is largely exemplary - no statistic over 852 or 600 points carries an independence-based uncertainty - but the deliverable contains one moderate reporting error (odd/even cycling 'per cycle' slopes inflated 2x by a rescaled index), one moderate unit-assertion defect (labelling power_density/rate as volts), and six minor numeric/wording errors, none of which changes any scientific conclusion. I flag as unreported that the abscissae are severely non-uniform (gaps up to 754x the median step) and that charge settings 6/7 reduce the charge family to at most 6 independent levels.
